goal: A mobile-first traversable Earth baseline with real terrain, imagery, buildings, approved Guild sites, Modern Wonders, Ancient Relic Cities, and expandable landmark coverage before CONVERGENCE-specific world deformation is layered in.
principles: Preserve real-world geography as the baseline.
Do not replace important locations with crude invented geometry when sourced or research-backed assets are available.
Use progressive LOD so the same Earth can scale from globe view to street-level inspection.
Keep approved CONVERGENCE canon separate from illustrative prototypes.
Every important location must have an explicit provenance and implementation state.

earthDefinitionOfDone: Globe loads on iPhone without a blank-screen failure.
Satellite imagery, terrain, country context, and streamed buildings have graceful fallbacks.
Approved Guild sites, Modern Wonders, Ancient Relic Cities, and major landmarks are searchable and selectable.
Camera transitions support globe, regional, city, building, and ground inspection without abrupt quality jumps.
Important locations have recognizable architecture or an explicit asset-production state instead of anonymous blocks.
Each external dataset and architectural asset has attribution/provenance tracked.
The web atlas can act as a reliable planning reference for UE5 world-building rather than a disconnected prototype.
